resources.string: Tap a playlist to watch it. Tuned keeps one playlist\'s channels at a time, so switching downloads the other one.
Its login is deleted from this device. You can add it again later.
It\'s your only playlist, so this signs you out and clears the saved channels and guide.
Add a playlist from your TV provider to start watching. You can add as many as you like later in Settings.
What did your provider give you?
A server address, username and password
An M3U or M3U8 web link, with a guide link if you have one
An .m3u file saved on this device
Enter the details your provider sent you. You can also paste a whole Xtream link into the server box.
Paste the playlist link your provider sent you.
This is an Xtream login link, so Tuned will sign in with it and catch-up works too.
Pick a playlist file. Tuned keeps its own copy, so it still works if you move or delete the original.
Keep the current file, or choose a new one
